newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-BECKER MISSES TRADITIONAL WIMBLEDON WARMUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER MISSES TRADITIONAL WIMBLEDON WARMUP.

text.p: Boris Becker will not be defending his Queen's Club grasscourt title this year.
The German shot to prominence at the 1985 tournament, using it as a prelude to his first Wimbledon title and followed up with victories in 1987, 1988 and again last year.
Organisers fear Becker's absence may be connected with a new tournament in Halle, Germany which clashes with the June 9-15 Queen's Club event.
Top names expected include Michael Chang, Goran Ivanisevic and Briton Tim Henman. Pete Sampras may be added as a wild card entry.
